title: Delivery Center Manager
requiredSkills: Own delivery across every client programme running from the centre - quality, SLA and capacity.
Lead the leadership team at the centre: team leads, quality and support functions.
Plan headcount and shifts against forecast volume, and work with recruitment on hiring for the centre.
Own the people agenda locally - onboarding, DTOUCH training uptake, retention and progression.
Keep the centre compliant with our information-security and process standards, including ISO 27001 obligations, and ready for client audit.
Act as the senior local point of contact for client visits and escalations.
Substantial experience in operations or delivery management, including managing managers.
A track record running a multi-team site or a large delivery programme to committed service levels.
Strength in the people side of the job - hiring, developing and keeping teams, including first-time employees.
Confidence in front of enterprise clients, and sound judgement about what to escalate.
A bachelor's degree; a management qualification is welcome but not required.
Willingness to be based at the centre and to travel occasionally between sites.

Helpful, not required: exposure to intelligent document processing or finance automation.

title: QA Automation Engineer
requiredSkills: Write and maintain automated functional and regression tests for web applications.
Convert existing manual test cases into reliable automated coverage, and retire the ones that no longer earn their place.
Keep suites trustworthy: investigate failures, fix flakiness, and keep run times short enough to stay in the release path.
Integrate test runs into CI so results reach the team on every build.
Work with client engineering teams on defects - reproduce, isolate and report clearly enough to act on.
Hands-on experience automating tests for web applications with a modern framework such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar.
Working knowledge of at least one programming language used for test automation - JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java or C#.
An understanding of test design: what to automate, what to leave manual, and why.
Familiarity with version control, CI pipelines and defect tracking.
A degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
Helpful, not required: API testing, performance testing, or accessibility testing experience.

title: RLHF Quality Analyst
requiredSkills: Review and rank model responses for helpfulness, accuracy and safety against a written rubric.
Apply trust & safety policy to borderline content and record why a call was made, not only what it was.
Flag rubric gaps and recurring ambiguity so the guideline gets fixed rather than worked around.
Take part in calibration sessions and golden-set checks that keep judgement consistent across the team.
Maintain the quality bar under deadline without drifting from the rubric.
Strong reading comprehension and written English - this is the core skill of the role.
Evident care with detail and the patience for repetitive, judgement-heavy work.
Willingness to have your judgement measured, discussed and corrected in calibration.
A bachelor's degree in any discipline, or equivalent experience. This role is open to candidates early in their career; the training is provided.
Helpful, not required: content moderation, editorial, teaching, linguistics or translation experience, or a second Indian language.

title: Senior Annotation Lead
requiredSkills: Run day-to-day delivery for an annotation programme: throughput, quality and turnaround against the client SLA.
Own the L1/L2/L3 review structure - sampling, golden-set checks and the feedback loop back to annotators.
Translate a client's labelling guidelines into instructions a team can apply consistently, and keep them current as edge cases surface.
Lead, coach and grow a team of annotators and reviewers, including people new to the field.
Work with client-side ML and data teams on guideline changes, quality disputes and volume planning.
Several years in data annotation, data operations or a comparable quality-led delivery role, including time leading a team.
Direct experience of an annotation quality system - sampling, inter-annotator agreement, golden sets or an equivalent.
Comfort with at least one annotation toolchain, and the judgement to know when a guideline is ambiguous rather than the annotator being wrong.
Clear written English: most guideline and escalation work happens in writing with client teams.
A bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience in a delivery or quality role.
Helpful, not required: 2D/3D LiDAR or sensor-fusion annotation, or experience in autonomous mobility, geospatial or robotics data.
